channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from FMallSectionsDR, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: TikTok reaches $400 million settlement in children's privacy case
item.description: TikTok and ByteDance have agreed to pay $400 million to settle claims they violated children's online privacy laws.

item.title: To Lower Beef Prices, Trump Should Aid Struggling Farmers in Expanding Herds
item.description: Rather than seeking short-term fixes for beef prices before the midterms, the administration should support farmers in increasing production.

item.title: Protester Removed from Trump Rally Wearing 'Kill Your Local Pedophile' Shirt
item.description: Two protesters were removed from a Trump rally in Myrtle Beach, including one with a shirt reading 'Kill Your Local Pedophile.'

item.title: Leavitt to Join Trump's Super PAC After Leaving White House
item.description: Outgoing press secretary Karoline Leavitt will join Trump's super PAC MAGA Inc. after leaving her White House role.
